summary: Dynamic jump folding: after seeing '@L; 0;JMP' once, the CPU loads PC = L together with A when it next fetches that @L, skipping the 0;JMP cycle. Uses an 8-entry direct-mapped table (RAM8) indexed by pc[0..2].

characteristics.cycle_compatible_with_spec: only until the first folded jump
characteristics.expected_cycle_effect: one cycle saved per repeated unconditional jump after an A-instruction

changes: CPU.hdl: prevpc register, prevA/prevreset DFFs, learn and fold logic
limitations: Assumes instruction memory does not change while running (true for ROM32K).
Only the canonical encoding 1110101010000111 (0;JMP) is folded; conditional jumps and other unconditional encodings are not.
Adds roughly 50 built-in part instances and puts a table lookup in front of the PC update; delay and area are not measured.
